claims: Artemis II is using NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) rocket is the most powerful operational rocket in the world.
NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) rocket is 322 feet tall.
NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) rocket utilizes four RS-25 engines.
NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) rocket utilizes two solid rocket boosters.
NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) rocket is designed to launch the crewed Orion spacecraft to the Moon.
Liftoff for Artemis II using NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) rocket occurs from Launch Pad 39B at Kennedy Space Center.
